verdictTaxonomy.INPUT_INVALID: schema-valid JSON that fails semantic closure, typing or frozen-binding checks
verdictTaxonomy.WITNESS_INVALID: a supplied trace or proof object is malformed, unreachable, mismatched or not replayable
verdictTaxonomy.UNKNOWN_INPUT_NOT_PROVEN: required evidence is absent or not independently checkable
verdictTaxonomy.MODEL_COUNTEREXAMPLE: a valid reachable member of the frozen model reaches BadConcrete or falsifies safety reflection
verdictTaxonomy.D2_SOUND: all bounded product obligations pass; unavailable while any required witness is draft, opaque or missing

productSemantics.abstractSafetyRule: no reachable BadAbstract state up to H
productSemantics.reflectionRule: every reachable BadConcrete state up to H projects to BadAbstract

invariants.name: binding-closure
invariants.obligation: every resource binding resolves to exactly one organization, owner, authoritative sink and sink ACL

invariants.name: lts-closure
invariants.obligation: initial/terminal/bad states and every transition endpoint/event resolve in the declared LTS

invariants.name: alpha-total-functional
invariants.obligation: alpha state/event maps are total and functional on every concrete state/event reachable within horizon

invariants.name: fault-membership
invariants.obligation: derive fault automaton state from its explicit transition table by replaying concrete fault events and normal-event self loops; never trust supplied faultRun

invariants.name: trace-reachability
invariants.obligation: replay every supplied concrete trace edge from its declared base state; dangling, reordered or ambiguous witness edges are not model counterexamples

invariants.name: projection-equality
invariants.obligation: derive alpha(concreteTrace), remove only declared legal stutter events, and compare with declared abstractTrace; a supplied mismatch invalidates the witness

invariants.name: effect-map-well-formedness
invariants.obligation: every declared external effect has an explicit non-stutter abstract event and preserves identity/multiplicity fields required by the abstraction contract

invariants.name: effect-completeness-counterexample
invariants.obligation: after input and witness validation, any reachable frozen-model concrete effect omitted or misreflected by alpha is a semantic counterexample

invariants.name: bad-state-reflection
invariants.obligation: for every reachable concrete product state in the frozen model, BadConcrete implies BadAbstract(alpha(state))

invariants.name: terminal-closure
invariants.obligation: all valid reachable frozen-model paths closed at H satisfy terminal closure or expose a mapped abstract violation

invariants.name: receipt-replay
invariants.obligation: per-sink receipt content, effect/dedup key, transaction group, linearization index and pre/post hashes replay against the sink trace

invariants.name: cross-sink-atomicity
invariants.obligation: serializable decomposition is accepted only with explicit crash/recovery and all-or-none witness; serializability alone is insufficient

invariants.name: sealed-base-inheritance
invariants.obligation: each runtime variant inherits immutable base manifest/planning snapshot; mutation allowlist cannot alter planning axes

invariants.name: model-runtime-separation
invariants.obligation: modelled faults are checked against the frozen fault automaton; deployed-runtime faults never rewrite planning verdict and require conformance status

invariants.name: fail-closed-positive-claim
invariants.obligation: positive D2_SOUND requires complete mediation, complete maps, accepted fault semantics, replayable witnesses and no reachable counterexample
